sections.heading: 巴西东北甘蔗园中的记录与害虫地位（2004）
sections.heading_en: Record in sugar cane in Northeast Brazil and pest status (2004)
sections.heading_es: Registro en caña de azúcar del nordeste de Brasil y estatus de plaga (2004)

paragraphs.text: 据摘要，Miranda 等（2004）在巴西东北的甘蔗园记录科西波象白蚁（Nasutitermes coxipoensis），这是该种首次被报道与甘蔗相关联；研究认为该种不是潜在害虫。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the abstract, Miranda et al. (2004) recorded Nasutitermes coxipoensis in sugar cane plantations in Northeast Brazil, the first report of the species in association with sugar cane; the study considered it not to be a potential pest.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el resumen, Miranda et al. (2004) registraron Nasutitermes coxipoensis en plantaciones de caña de azúcar del nordeste de Brasil, el primer registro de la especie asociada a la caña de azúcar; el estudio la consideró no potencialmente plaga.

references.citation: Miranda, C. S.; Vasconcellos, A.; Bandeira, A. G. 2004. Termites in sugar cane in Northeast Brazil: ecological aspects and pest status. Neotropical Entomology.
